SERVICES

From a room remodel to a room addition -- planning to completion, we can make your project hassle-free with our own expert staff.

DESIGN

We look at each project as an empty canvas.  Your needs define space design. Our design professionals help you determine function and storage requirements -- colors and style -- necessities and wish lists. Then they go to work, creating a plan based on those needs, and your budget.

SELECTION

You will be able to select your cabinetry, counter tops, appliances and accessory options in our showroom.

EXPERIENCE

Our family has been providing our client families with custom design living spaces since 1946. Experience -- it is the most important thing we have to offer.

OUR WORK

DREAMING OF A NEW KITCHEN?

Dream no more! Complete renovations or new cabinets, large projects or small, we've helped so many people create the kitchen they've always wanted. Stop by our showroom. Let's get your kitchen design started. Modern Kitchen is here to help you redesign, remodel and relax.

GALLERY

Click on any image for a larger view.

View fullsize
View fullsize
View fullsize
View fullsize
View fullsize
View fullsize
TESTIMONIALS

Scroll through and read what our customers say about the Modern Kitchen experience.

Totally Pleased

"Modern Kitchen gave us the open concept kitchen we wanted—more counter space and additional seating. At Thanksgiving, honestly, we had 23 people here for dinner and it worked perfectly. We are totally pleased with Modern Kitchen. In fact after the kitchen, they remodeled our master bath, which we love. Next on the list is the guest bath. Our thanks to you, Mark, and your crew!"

 
Wow

"WOW - that's what we say to each other each day. We never thought we would have such a nice kitchen in this house. You guys were wonderful to work with and I especially appreciate the great communication. You always kept us informed of what was coming up and when there were changes and that was important to me. We are really, really happy that we went with Modern Kitchen and when the time comes to do our bathroom, there is only one business we will consider for the job. Thank you!"

 
Bathroom Of My Dreams

"I've always wanted a claw foot tub, modern kitchen fulfilled my wish list and gave me the bathroom of my dreams. I have complete confidence in Mark and Bunny to remodel my kitchen when the time comes."

 
No Surprises

"Mark is a hands on guy, a problem solver, there were no surprises and we're right on budget."

 
Someone To Do It All

"We are not do it yourselfers...we wanted someone to do it all and be responsible for it all."

 
Satisfied Customer

"I'm an interior designer so I basically knew what I wanted, and working with Dennis, I got it. Modern Kitchen has remodeled my last three kitchens....I guess you can say I'm a satisfied customer."

ABOUT

SERVICING SINCE 1946! 

Starting out, my grandpa Lance made cabinets by hand in his garage. The tradition continued in 1964 when my dad Steve joined him and I did so in 1986.

A lot has changed since our beginning, one thing hasn’t. Grandpa’s philosophy to be honest and give exceptional customer service. That is our commitment to you and your project.

We are three generation proud to have served so many of you and your remodeling needs.

We are here to help you Redesign, Remodel and Relax. 

— Mark Jones

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to provide exceptional kitchen and bath design services and products to builders, remodelers, and homeowners.

We do it by...

creating a team with the same work ethic established by our founder and continues with our management who live by the moral standard of care, respect, a positive attitude, and pride in our work.

being thoroughly professional

knowing our business and our customer's requirements knowledge and attention to detail are keys to our success.

skillfully integrating our designs and products to best meet the need of each customer we serve - sound advice and reliable products are the foundation of our company.

IN THE COMMUNITY

Indiana State Representatives Doug Miller, District 48 and Dale Devon, District 5 present Mark Jones with greetings and congratulations from Governor Eric Holcomb as Modern Kitchen celebrates their 75th anniversary.
